## Downloads

| Asset | Description |
|---|---|
| **Windows-Hinting-Portable-win-x64.exe** | Self-contained portable x64 build — signed single-file executable. No .NET runtime required. No UIAccess (hints won't appear above e.g. the start menu). Download and run. |
| **Windows-Hinting-Portable-win-x86.exe** | Self-contained portable x86 build — signed single-file executable. No .NET runtime required. No UIAccess (hints won't appear above e.g. the start menu). Download and run. |
| **Windows-Hinting-Debug.zip** | Debug build — **unsigned**, for diagnostics/testing only. Extract and run `Windows-Hinting.exe`. Requires [.NET 10 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0). |
| **Windows-Hinting.msi** | Installer — fully signed (installer, executable, and managed DLL). Provides UIAccess support so hints appear above e.g. the start menu. Requires [.NET 10 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0). |
